lines.text: ولادت حضرت امیرالمؤمنین ۱۳ رجب بوده و ضربت شهادت صبح اخر ۱۹ رمضان و انتقال
lines.en: The birth of His Holiness the Commander of the Faithful was on the 13th of Rajab, and the strike of martyrdom was on the morning of the end of the 19th of Ramadan, and the passing

lines.text: انحضرت ۲۱ رمضان ولادت حضرت فاطمه ۲۰ جمادی الاخر و انتقال انحضرت ۳ صفر ولادت
lines.en: of His Holiness was on the 21st of Ramadan. The birth of Her Holiness Fatima was on the 20th of Jumada al-Akhir, and the passing of Her Holiness was on the 3rd of Safar. The birth

lines.text: امام حسن ۱۵ رمضان وفات انحضرت ۳ جمادی الاخر ولادت حضرت امام حسین ۴
lines.en: of Imam Hasan was on the 15th of Ramadan, the death of His Holiness was on the 3rd of Jumada al-Akhir. The birth of His Holiness Imam Husayn was on the 4th

lines.text: ۳ شعبان و اصح سلخ ربیع الاول گفته اند انتقال انحضرت ۱۰ محرم ولادت حضرت امام
lines.en: of Sha'ban, and the most correct is the end of Rabi' al-Awwal, they have said. The passing of His Holiness was on the 10th of Muharram. The birth of His Holiness Imam

lines.text: امام زین العابدین ۵ شعبان وفات انحضرت ۲۲ محرم ولادت امام محمد باقر ۳ صفر
lines.en: Imam Zayn al-Abidin was on the 5th of Sha'ban, the death of His Holiness was on the 22nd of Muharram. The birth of Imam Muhammad Baqir was on the 3rd of Safar,

lines.text: وفات انحضرت هفتم ذی الحجه ولادت امام جعفر الصادق ۱۷ ربیع الاول شهادت انحضرت
lines.en: the death of His Holiness was on the seventh of Dhu al-Hijjah. The birth of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq was on the 17th of Rabi' al-Awwal, the martyrdom of His Holiness

lines.text: ۱۵ رجب ولادت امام موسی ۷ صفر شهادت انحضرت ۶ رجب ولادت امام رضا ۱۱
lines.en: was on the 15th of Rajab. The birth of Imam Musa was on the 7th of Safar, the martyrdom of His Holiness was on the 6th of Rajab. The birth of Imam Rida was on the 11th

lines.text: ذی قعده شهادت انحضرت ۱۷ صفر ولادت امام محمد تقی علیه السلام ۱۰ رجب و اصح ۱۹ رمضان
lines.en: of Dhu al-Qa'dah, the martyrdom of His Holiness was on the 17th of Safar. The birth of Imam Muhammad Taqi, peace be upon him, was on the 10th of Rajab, and the most correct is the 19th of Ramadan,

lines.text: وفات انحضرت نیز عاشر رجب ولادت امام علی النقی ۲ رجب و اصح ۱۵ ذی الحجه وفات انحضرت
lines.en: the death of His Holiness was also on the tenth of Rajab. The birth of Imam Ali al-Naqi was on the 2nd of Rajab, and the most correct is the 15th of Dhu al-Hijjah, the death of His Holiness

lines.text: سیم رجب ولادت امام حسن عسکری علیه السلام ۸ ربیع الاخر وفات انحضرت ۸ ربیع الاول
lines.en: was on the third of Rajab. The birth of Imam Hasan al-Askari, peace be upon him, was on the 8th of Rabi' al-Akhir, the death of His Holiness was on the 8th of Rabi' al-Awwal.

lines.text: ولادت امام محمد مهدی علیه السلام ۱۵ شعبان اما ایام مشهوره تاریخ روم برد و نوع است
lines.en: The birth of Imam Muhammad al-Mahdi, peace be upon him, was on the 15th of Sha'ban. But the famous days of the Roman calendar are of two types:

lines.text: یکی انکه موقوف موقوف باشد بر معرفت اول صوم کبیر که منسوبست بطایفه نصاری و دوم
lines.en: One is that which is dependent on the knowledge of the beginning of the Great Fast, which is attributed to the Christian sect, and the second

lines.text: انکه موقوف نیست ذکر آن چه موقوفست بر معرفت صوم کبیر مخفی نماند که صوم کبیره که
lines.en: is that which is not dependent. The mention of that which is dependent on the knowledge of the Great Fast: Let it not remain hidden that the Great Fast, which

lines.text: روزه فریضه نصاریست هفت هفته است و حسن بصری و بعضی دیگر از مفسرین گفته اند که انچه
lines.en: is the obligatory fast of the Christians, is seven weeks. And Hasan al-Basri and some other commentators have said that what

lines.text: خدا تعالی بر امت عیسی ع واجب گردانیده یکماه بود و چون انماه در تابستان افتاد از فرط حرارت
lines.en: God Almighty made obligatory upon the nation of Jesus, peace be upon him, was one month. And when that month fell in the summer, due to the extreme heat,

lines.text: مواشقت تمام باحوال مردم راه یافت پس علمای ایشان در این باب اندیشه نمودند صوم را
lines.en: great hardship found its way into the condition of the people. So their scholars pondered on this matter, and the fast

lines.text: بفصل ربیع انداختند و ده روز زیاده نمودند و همچنین هر قومی از ایشان زیاده مینمودند
lines.en: they moved to the spring season and added ten days. And likewise, every group of them would add to it,

lines.text: تا چهل و نه روز شد و اول این صوم همیشه روز دوشنبه باشد مشروط بانکه روز دهم شباط
lines.en: until it became forty-nine days. And the beginning of this fast is always on a Monday, provided that the tenth day of Shubat

lines.text: و بعد از هفتم از ان نباشد صوم نینوی روز دوشنبه باشد پیش از اول صوم کبیر به هجده روز
lines.en: and after the seventh of it is not. The Fast of Nineveh is on a Monday, eighteen days before the beginning of the Great Fast.

summary.headline: Imams’ Dates and Christian Fasts
summary.text: Dates of birth, martyrdom, and passing for the Twelve Imams and Fatima, followed by an account of the Roman calendar’s two kinds of notable days and the Christian Great Fast, including the Fast of Nineveh.
